title: Daily Devotional #48
paragraphs: As I read Luke 4, I am reminded of Your steadfast love and Your unwavering commitment to Your purpose. In this chapter, we see Jesus being led by the Spirit into the wilderness, where He fasted for forty days and was tempted by the devil. Yet despite the devil's attempts to distract and derail Him, Jesus remained focused on Your will and Your plan.

Lord, I am struck by the fact that even though Jesus was fully God, He still chose to humble Himself and take on human form. He experienced hunger, thirst, and temptation just like we do. But unlike us, He never sinned. He always chose obedience to You, even when it was difficult.

Father, I pray that You would help me to follow Jesus' example. Help me to resist temptation and to always choose Your will over my own desires. Help me to remember that You have a plan and a purpose for my life, just as You did for Jesus.

Lord, I also see in this chapter that Jesus began His ministry by preaching in the synagogues and healing the sick. He proclaimed that He had come to bring good news to the poor, to proclaim freedom for prisoners and recovery of sight for the blind, to release the oppressed, and to proclaim the year of the Lord's favor.

Father, I pray that You would help me to be a vessel for Your good news. Help me to share Your love with those who are hurting, to proclaim freedom to those who are enslaved by sin, and to bring hope to those who are oppressed. Help me to be Your hands and feet in this world.
Lord, I am so grateful for Your love and for the example that Jesus set for us. Help me to follow Him faithfully, and to always keep my eyes fixed on You.
